design_summary: Paired paper-review replay of stored submissions from the supplied completed simulations under regime A (one standardized reviewer policy) vs regime B (heterogeneous reviewer-priority profiles). Primary causal estimand = A - B with all other reviewer attributes held fixed. Regime C = original stored reviews as zero-cost ecological reference (replayed only on the smoke set for reconstruction sanity; never a causal comparison).

smoke.purpose: engineering validation only; disjoint from pilot; never enters any pilot hypothesis test
smoke.allocation: roughly 5/5/5/5/4 per source seed, sampled by the same stratified procedure before pilot sampling, then removed from the eligible pool

stability_subset.rule: from the 300 pilot papers, stratify by strategy (explorer/exploiter/cautious_explorer) x novelty tercile (within pilot sample) x original decision (2); allocate 60 proportionally to cell counts by deterministic largest-remainder; within-cell selection ordered by paper_id with rng seeded derive_seed(42,'stability_subset'); receives a second blind panel (panel=2) in regimes A and B only

sampling_design.eligibility: row in paper.parquet with a matching review round in the submission-year checkpoint (matched on year and conference; loud failure on ambiguity), exactly 3 reviewer entries whose reviewer_ids resolve to agents in ecosystem_data.agents of that checkpoint, non-empty abstract
sampling_design.initial_cell: source_seed x year_tercile x distance_bucket x accepted
collapse_algorithm: A cell is sparse if its eligible count < 8 or below its largest-remainder allocation
step 1: merge adjacent year terciles within the same source_seed x distance_bucket x accepted class (1-3 with 4-6 first, then with 7-10 if still sparse)
step 2: if still sparse, merge distance buckets (near->mid->far adjacency) within the same source_seed x accepted class
never merge accepted with rejected papers
sampling_design.quota_allocation: fixed 60 papers per source seed allocated proportionally to final-cell eligible counts by deterministic largest-remainder; within-cell selection ordered by paper_id with rng seeded derive_seed(42,'corpus_sample',source_seed)
sampling_design.inclusion_probability: P(selected | source_seed, final collapsed cell) = selected_in_cell / eligible_in_cell; stored per paper with original cell id, final cell id, eligible N, selected n, and IPW weight = 1/inclusion_probability
sampling_design.effective_sample_size: reported as (sum w)^2 / sum w^2 over pilot papers

regimes.A_standardized: one common policy block for every slot of every paper
regimes.B_heterogeneous: one of six frozen priority profiles per slot; 3 distinct profiles per paper chosen by derive_seed('profile_assign', paper_id, slot); fixed per (paper, slot) across panels and arms
regimes.C_reference: original stored reviews from checkpoints (all 300 pilot papers, zero cost); C replay (reconstructed original agents, year-filtered memory, unmodified prompt path) executed only for the 24 smoke papers as a reconstruction sanity check

held_fixed_across_A_B: reviewer-slot domain expertise = original slot reviewer's expertise topic list
memory policy (empty memory bank; memory block omitted)
model, revision, temperature, max_tokens, thinking mode
prestige metadata (identical author identifier, institution strings, relationship sentence per arm)
prompt template and insertion point of the policy block
manipulated_A_vs_B: reviewer-policy block text only: one standardized balanced policy (A) vs slot-specific priority profile (B)
manipulation_table.request_seeds: deterministic but regime-specific (seed_ctx = ('review_replay', corpus_version, chunk_index) with fixed task ordering and fixed 512-task chunks); NO claim of common-random-number pairing across regimes

prompt_construction.base: unmodified SimulationAgent.get_review_prompt(paper, author_info) called on a SimulationAgent carrying the slot expertise and empty memory_bank
prompt_construction.policy_text_A: You apply the conference's standard review policy: weigh methodological soundness, novelty, clarity, significance, and feasibility evenly. Base your score only on the paper's content as presented, applying the scoring rubric consistently and impartially.

policy_texts_B.rigor: As a reviewer you prioritize methodological rigor above all: scrutinize the soundness of methods, the validity of experiments, and whether the claims are fully supported by the evidence.
policy_texts_B.novelty: As a reviewer you prioritize novelty and originality above all: reward genuinely new ideas, unexpected combinations, and departures from established approaches, and be less moved by incremental polish.
policy_texts_B.feasibility: As a reviewer you prioritize practicality and feasibility above all: assess whether the approach is realistic, reproducible, and implementable with the stated resources.
policy_texts_B.impact: As a reviewer you prioritize potential impact above all: weigh how much the work could change the field or enable important applications if adopted.
policy_texts_B.clarity: As a reviewer you prioritize clarity and presentation above all: assess whether the problem, method, and evidence are communicated precisely and accessibly.
policy_texts_B.interdisciplinarity: As a reviewer you prioritize interdisciplinary value above all: reward work that bridges fields, transfers methods across domains, or speaks to audiences beyond its home area.

prestige_intervention.name: synthetic institutional-prestige cue intervention
prestige_intervention.scope_statement: measures the effect of a synthetic institutional-standing cue only; not author-identity bias, status bias in general, preferential attachment, or real institutional prestige
prestige_intervention.relationship_both_arms: You have no prior relationship with this author.
prestige_intervention.institution_high: Northlake Institute of Technology, a research university widely regarded as one of the leading institutions in this field
prestige_intervention.institution_low: Westbrook State University, a university with a modest standing in this field
prestige_intervention.difference_constraint: the two arm prompts differ only in the institution string above (standing only; no resources, quality, productivity, funding, career stage, or network differences)
manipulation_diagnostics: exact prompt-diff validation per paper (arms differ only in the frozen prestige block)
keyword scan of review texts for mentions/apparent use of the prestige cue (no score effect required)
regime B: profile-assignment balance and a blinded keyword/embedding profile-adherence summary

task_grid.pilot: 300 papers x 2 regimes (A,B) x 3 arms (blind, prestige_high, prestige_low) x 3 slots = 5400 calls
task_grid.smoke: 24 papers x same grid = 432 calls (+ optional C replay <= 144 calls)
task_grid.stability: 60 papers x 2 regimes x 1 blind arm x 3 slots (panel=2) = 360 calls

primary_endpoints.endpoint: within-paper reviewer-score dispersion: SD (ddof=1) of the 3 raw slot scores, blind arm, per paper per regime
primary_endpoints.test: two-sided, paper-level paired bootstrap (10000), BH family

primary_endpoints.endpoint: within-paper rationale semantic diversity: mean pairwise cosine distance among MiniLM (all-MiniLM-L6-v2, snapshot 1110a243) embeddings of the 3 blind-arm justifications, per paper per regime
primary_endpoints.test: two-sided, paper-level paired bootstrap (10000), BH family; length-adjusted sensitivity (residualize on mean justification length); longer text is never interpreted as more diverse by itself

primary_endpoints.endpoint: novelty-by-regime interaction, paired paper-level: delta_score_i = mean3(raw blind A) - mean3(raw blind B); weighted model delta_score_i = b0 + b1*novelty_i using frozen IPW weights; b1 is the estimand
primary_endpoints.hypothesized_direction: negative (heterogeneous panels containing a novelty-prioritizing profile reward novelty more, so A-B declines with novelty)
primary_endpoints.test: two-sided, IPW-weighted paper-level bootstrap (10000) for b1, BH family; stacked A/B and review-level clustered models are sensitivity only
primary_endpoints.mie_units: score points per unit novelty_score (novelty_score in [0,1])

primary_endpoints.endpoint: synthetic institutional-prestige cue difference-in-differences: d_i^R = mean3(raw prestige_high) - mean3(raw prestige_low) within regime R; estimand = mean over papers of (d_A_i - d_B_i)
primary_endpoints.hypothesized_direction: two-sided (no frozen sign; monoculture may amplify or uniformly suppress the cue)
primary_endpoints.test: two-sided, paper-level paired bootstrap (10000), BH family

multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg across the 4 primary endpoints at alpha=0.05; all other analyses secondary/exploratory with internal BH per family

score_conventions.sensitivity: int-cast score (matches frozen simulator convention run_simulation.py:2512)
score_conventions.reporting: fraction of raw scores with non-zero fractional part; if ~0 state raw and int analyses are effectively equivalent

secondary_analyses: ICC(1) and interval Krippendorff alpha per regime (only if cleanly implemented and unit-tested; non-blocking)

acceptance, absolute-score rule: frozen original per-(conference,year) threshold = midpoint between lowest accepted and highest rejected original mean score in the FULL original cohort; applied to every condition; measures score-level shifts

acceptance, capacity-constrained sensitivity: rank replay papers within condition x conference-year, accept the original venue proportion (0.30); measures decision changes under fixed capacity; never conflated with the absolute rule
panel stability (60-paper subset): decision flip rate between panel 1 and panel 2 within regime; Jaccard of accepted sets

original-review comparison (C reference): Pearson and Spearman correlation, mean bias, distribution distance (TV and Wasserstein), acceptance-decision agreement, justification-length comparison, slot-level calibration; prompt fidelity reported separately from behavioral fidelity; weak fidelity downgrades C to exploratory and does not affect A-B
inference: paper-level paired bootstrap (10000 resamples) primary; two-level source_seed->paper bootstrap as robustness (5 seed clusters, limitation stated)

weighting_rules.unweighted: paired within-paper A-B contrasts (P1, P2, P4) primary; IPW-weighted versions as sensitivity
weighting_rules.ipw_weighted: P3 primary and all population-level quantities (acceptance rates, novelty slopes, strategy disparities, accepted-paper diversity)
weighting_rules.prohibition: the balanced-sample acceptance rate is never reported as the E3.5 population acceptance rate

missingness_rules.slot_level: a slot failing all retries leaves the paper's other slots intact
missingness_rules.cell_validity: a (paper, regime, arm) cell is valid if >= 2 of 3 slots parsed; invalid cells exclude the paper from endpoints requiring that cell, counted in the missingness report
missingness_rules.P4_requirement: all four cells (A/B x high/low) valid
missingness_rules.leakage: papers with leakage-excluded prompts are replaced at sampling time (before generation); replacements drawn by the same deterministic procedure; recorded in leakage_exclusions.csv

blind_leakage_scanner: section-aware: paper-content section may contain title/abstract/topics; reviewer-memory, reviewer-profile, system-context, author-information and auxiliary sections must not contain author identity, submitting institution, collaboration/funding metadata, original acceptance outcome, future citations, hidden strategy labels, or evidence the reviewer previously saw the current submission; C replay additionally checks for the current title inside reviewer memory; offending section and reason logged
completion_gate: 4 primary endpoints reported with effect sizes and clustered CIs
recommendation_rule: validity-based: design validity, CI precision relative to minimal-interesting effects, interpretability, feasibility; statistical significance is never the criterion; effects reported as positive/null/inconclusive
optional_non_blocking: seed sensitivity: at most 2 additional global seeds on a fixed preregistered subset of at most 50 pilot papers, run only after the primary pilot and analysis complete, skipped if time-limited, never a completion requirement
